title: Non-Asymptotic Variational Learning for Monotone Nonlinear Multiscale Elliptic Equations: Scale-Robust Primal-Dual Bounds and Strong-Form Statistical Ill-Conditioning
summary: We develop a non-asymptotic approximation, sampling, and finite-iteration optimization theory for variational physics-informed approximation of uniformly monotone nonlinear multiscale elliptic equations. For boundary-compatible neural feature classes, the population error splits into approximation, empirical quadrature, and projected-gradient terms, with all non-approximation constants uniform in the microscopic scale \(\varepsilon\).
